vocabulary.definition: 一次施放或一次攻击能对多个敌方单位造成伤害
移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果
移除目标身上可被强驱散的效果（含多数眩晕）
降低目标护甲
让普通攻击附带额外效果：减甲、减速、减疗、烧蓝、额外伤害、中毒、降低属性等；有概率触发或只强化下一次攻击也算。单纯提高攻击力、攻速，以及吸血、暴击、分裂弹射归各自词条
使敌方单位的攻击有概率落空
说明明确写打断持续施法；眩晕、沉默等已有控制不重复记
技能或物品用一次消耗一点；只决定数值或层数的不算
立刻重置冷却
处于减益免疫（技能免疫）时，只有能穿透减益免疫的效果才对其生效（如碎颅锤的重击可以眩晕开了黑皇杖的单位）
提供额外金钱或经验；只是正常赏金不算
自身有概率使敌方攻击落空
飞行移动，能越过地形
提供目标或区域的视野
恢复生命值（治疗、生命恢复），含属性生命恢复（如治疗指环+4.5）
让目标受到更多物理伤害或全部伤害（只加深魔法的归上一项）
使自身、队友、召唤物或复制体隐身
攻击或技能恢复自身生命：按造成的伤害、按目标生命或每次攻击固定值（攻击吸血、技能吸血、如噬魂鬼·盛宴、附魂面具）
降低目标魔抗，或让目标受到更多魔法或技能伤害
为自己恢复或从其他单位抽取法力（如莱恩法力吸取），含属性回蓝和回蓝倍率；对友军生效且能给自己回蓝的也算
主动使已飞来的弹道落空；“无法被躲避”的说明不算
使隐身单位显形，不等于持续真视
目标无法移动；带ROOT_DISABLES字段的位移（所有闪烁类）也不能使用
闪烁、冲刺、跳跃、传送等主动改变自身位置
目标无法施放技能（仍可攻击、使用物品）
降低移动速度或攻击速度
使指向自身或队友的技能失效
把指向技能反弹给施法者
使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
可看见隐身单位

objects.subject: huskar_berserkers_blood
objects.description_zh: 哈斯卡的伤痛赐予他力量，根据他损失的生命值将获得攻击速度、魔法抗性和生命恢复加成。生命恢复为力量的一定百分比。
objects.description_en: Huskar's injuries feed his power, giving increased attack speed, magic resistance and health regen based on missing health. Health regen is a percentage of your strength.
notes_zh: 加成效果为线性增加，满血时没有加成，%hp_threshold_max%%%生命时达到最大加成。

shard.zh:
哈斯卡可以消耗一定生命来主动开启狂战士之血，炙疗哈斯卡。进行驱散，然后在一定延迟后回复消耗的生命，并且每驱散一个负面状态，他就会额外回复生命。

驱散类型：弱驱散
shard.en: Huskar can activate Berserker's Blood for a health cost to cauterize himself. Dispels Huskar, then after a delay, heals for the amount of health consumed plus an additional bonus per debuff dispelled.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

objects.subject: huskar_blood_magic
objects.description_zh: 哈斯卡没有魔法值。物品的魔法消耗会转换为生命消耗。哈斯卡的生命消耗为魔法伤害，可以被魔法抗性减少。
objects.description_en: Huskar does not have mana. Mana costs of items are converted into health costs.Huskar's Health Costs are Magical Damage and can be reduced by Magic Resist.

objects.subject: huskar_life_break
objects.description_zh:
哈斯卡牺牲自己的生命来摧毁敌人的生命，他跃向一个目标，造成目标当前生命值一定百分比的伤害，并且降低目标的移动和攻击速度。哈斯卡在跳跃过程中为减益免疫，并且魔法抗性提升%immunity_resist%%%。

驱散类型：弱驱散
objects.description_en:
Huskar draws upon his health to break an enemy's life, leaping at a target to shatter a percentage of that hero's current health and slow both their movement and attack speed.  While leaping, Huskar is Debuff Immune with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes_zh: 如果哈斯卡在跳跃时受到控制技能，或目标在0.015秒内移动1400码以上，跳跃就会停止。
减速效果无视减益免疫。
牺牲无法被躲避。

scepter.zh: 强迫敌方目标攻击哈斯卡，并提升施法距离。
scepter.en: Forces the enemy target to attack Huskar and increases cast range.

objects.subject: night_stalker_void
objects.description_zh: 制造一个伤害性的虚空，对一个敌方单位造成减速及伤害。夜晚时虚空可以造成短暂眩晕，打断持续施法，并且效果的持续时间更长。
objects.description_en: Creates a damaging void that slows an enemy unit and deals damage. At night, Void also mini-stuns, interrupting channeling abilities, and its effects lasts longer.
notes_zh: 虚空在白天不会对敌人造成眩晕。

shard.zh: 虚空现在影响目标范围内所有单位。
shard.en: Void now affects all units in a radius around the target.

objects.subject: night_stalker_crippling_fear
objects.description_zh: 暗夜魔王恐吓附近所有敌人，使他们在他身边时被沉默，并受到伤害。效果在夜晚持续更久。
objects.description_en: Night Stalker horrifies all nearby enemies, causing them to become silenced and take damage over time while near him.  The effect lasts longer at night.

objects.subject: night_stalker_midnight_feast
objects.description_zh: 暗夜魔王攻击敌方单位时治疗自身。在夜晚可以主动施放，秒杀一个非远古非英雄单位，并回复暗夜魔王的最大生命值和最大魔法值的一定百分比。
objects.description_en: Night Stalker heals himself when attacking enemy units. At night, the ability can be activated to instantly destroy a non-ancient creep and restore a percentage of Night Stalker's maximum health and mana.
notes_zh: 攻击获得的生命值受到生命回复的影响，攻击非英雄目标时会减少。

objects.subject: night_stalker_hunter_in_the_night
objects.description_zh: 暗夜魔王在夜晚如鱼得水，攻击和移动都变得迅速。
objects.description_en: Night Stalker is in his element at night, attacking and moving with great swiftness.

scepter.zh: 移动速度加成提升%bonus_bonus_movement_speed_pct_night%%%，攻击速度加成提升%bonus_bonus_attack_speed_night%。击杀敌方英雄会重置所有基础技能的冷却时间。
scepter.en: Increases bonus movement speed by %bonus_bonus_movement_speed_pct_night%%% and attack speed by %bonus_bonus_attack_speed_night%. Killing an enemy hero resets all basic ability cooldowns.

objects.subject: night_stalker_darkness
objects.description_zh: 暗夜魔王遮住太阳，让夜晚立刻降临，使他的力量可以得到最大程度的发挥。在此期间暗夜魔王获得飞行能力和攻击力加成。拥有顺畅视野。
objects.description_en: Night Stalker smothers the sun and summons instant darkness, so that he might use his powers at their fullest. Night Stalker gains flight and bonus damage during this time. Has unobstructed vision.

objects.subject: broodmother_insatiable_hunger
objects.description_zh: 对活物体液的强烈饥渴提高了育母蜘蛛的攻击力，并使她和她的小蜘蛛的攻击附带吸血效果。
objects.description_en: A violent lust for vital fluids increases Broodmother's attack damage and gives her and her Spiderlings a vampiric attack.

shard.zh: 开启极度饥渴后，攻击力加成每%shard_damage_tick_interval%秒提升%shard_damage_per_tick%%%。
shard.en: While Hunger is active, the bonus damage is increased by %shard_damage_per_tick%%% every %shard_damage_tick_interval%s.

objects.subject: broodmother_spin_web
objects.description_zh: 编织出一张蜘蛛网，育母蜘蛛在蛛网里被动提升移动速度和转身速率，并且获得无视地形移动的能力。织网现在可向其他蛛网触及的区域全地图施放。蛛网永久存在，不过可以手动摧毁。当其数量超过上限，最早的蛛网将会消失。
objects.description_en: Spins a large web that grants Broodmother a passive movement speed increase and increases her Turn Rate, while in its vicinity, as well as giving free movement.Spin Web can be cast from anywhere as long as the new web touches an existing web. Webs never expire, and can be manually destroyed. When the maximum limit of webs is exceeded, the oldest web disappears.
notes_zh: 也会作用于小蜘蛛。

objects.subject: broodmother_incapacitating_bite
objects.description_zh: 育母蜘蛛用毒液削弱敌方单位，使她的攻击带有减速效果，中毒单位的攻击有一定概率落空，并且被攻击时承受额外伤害。
objects.description_en: Broodmother's venom cripples enemy units, causing her attacks to slow and giving the affected unit a chance to miss its attacks and extra damage from attacks.
notes_zh: 攻击落空几率与闪避和上下坡丢失叠加。

objects.subject: broodmother_sticky_snare
objects.description_zh: 育母蜘蛛可以制造出最多%count%个触碰已有蛛网的隐形网线。敌方英雄穿过网线将会触发陷阱，被缠绕，在战争迷雾中显形，并持续受到伤害。网线一开始被触发后，多名英雄还可以在同根网线上被绊倒，直到网线被摧毁。只要有人触发陷阱，育母蜘蛛的队友就会在小地图上发现。
objects.description_en: Broodmother may create up to %count% invisible web lines touching any existing web. Enemy Heroes that cross the web line will spring the trap, becoming rooted, revealed in fog, and take damage over time.  Multiple Heroes can trip on the same line until it's destroyed after being initially triggered.  Broodmother's team is alerted via the minimap when an enemy has triggered the snare.

objects.subject: broodmother_spiders_milk
objects.description_zh: 育母蜘蛛击杀一个单位后，她和%kill_heal_aoe%范围内她控制的所有单位都会获得持续%kill_heal_duration%秒的状态效果，每%tick_rate%秒治疗一定生命，治疗量为遇害者生命值的一定百分比。非英雄单位提供的治疗量减少%kill_creeps_penalty%%%。
objects.description_en: Whenever Broodmother kills a unit, she and all units under her control in a %kill_heal_aoe% radius receive a buff for %kill_heal_duration%s that heals them for a percentage of the victim's health every %tick_rate% seconds. Healing from creeps is reduced by %kill_creeps_penalty%%%.

objects.subject: broodmother_spawn_spiderlings
objects.description_zh: 育母蜘蛛将她的卵注入敌人体内，造成伤害和减速，持续%slow_duration%秒。如果目标在感染期间被击杀，卵会孵化成小蜘蛛。
objects.description_en: Broodmother injects her young into an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing them for %slow_duration% seconds. The spiderlings will hatch if the target is killed while under this influence.
notes_zh: 如果目标在受到此技能后%buff_duration%秒内被杀死，小蜘蛛就会孵化。
被小蜘蛛杀死的单位会生出额外的小蜘蛛。

objects.subject: bounty_hunter_shuriken_toss
objects.description_zh: 向一个敌方单位掷出一枚致命的飞镖，对目标造成伤害，并且减缓目标的移动速度。只要目标周围%bounce_aoe%范围内存在被追踪术标记的单位，飞镖就能向其弹射。
objects.description_en: Hurls a deadly shuriken at an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing the target's movement speed.  The shuriken will bounce to any Tracked units who are within a %bounce_aoe% radius of each other.

scepter.zh: 提升施法距离并且击中时施加忍术。
scepter.en: Increases cast range and applies Jinada on hit.

objects.subject: bounty_hunter_jinada
objects.description_zh: 赏金猎人准备好他的下次攻击，造成额外伤害并窃取若干不可靠金钱。
objects.description_en: Bounty Hunter plans his next hit, dealing bonus damage and stealing some unreliable gold.

objects.subject: bounty_hunter_wind_walk
objects.description_zh: 赏金猎人进入隐身，获得移动速度加成，并能够穿越其它单位，直到他攻击或使用技能。破隐一击会短暂眩晕目标。
objects.description_en: Bounty Hunter becomes invisible and gains bonus movement speed and the ability to move through other units until he attacks or casts a spell.  If he breaks the invisibility with an attack, that attack will stun the target for a short duration.
notes_zh: 开启后不会打断大多数持续施法技能。

objects.subject: bounty_hunter_wind_walk_ally
objects.description_zh: 对友军目标施加暗影步及其所有加成效果。友方单位的渐隐时间是%fade_time%秒。施放时不会使赏金猎人脱离隐身状态。
objects.description_en: Applies Shadow Walk and all of its bonuses to the target ally. Allied fade time is %fade_time%s. Does not break Bounty Hunter's invisibility when cast.

objects.subject: bounty_hunter_big_game_hunter
objects.description_zh: 如果阵亡的敌人是重大目标，赏金猎人获得的击杀和助攻金钱提升%kill_assist_gold_bonus_percent%%%。敌方英雄的财产总和在他们团队中排名为前三就被视为重大目标。
objects.description_en: Bounty Hunter receives %kill_assist_gold_bonus_percent%%% more kill and assist gold if the dying enemy hero is Big Game. An enemy hero is considered Big Game if they are one of the top 3 net worth heroes on the enemy team.

objects.subject: bounty_hunter_track
objects.description_zh: 追踪一个敌方英雄，获得目标的真实视域，使目标受到的伤害增加，同时掌握目标当前携带的金钱数额。如果目标在被追踪期间死亡，赏金猎人和附近友方英雄都将获得若干金钱奖励。施放追踪术不会脱离隐身。
objects.description_en: Tracks an enemy hero, granting True Sight of the target, increasing the damage they take and providing information on how much gold it is carrying. If the target dies, Bounty Hunter and nearby heroes collect a bonus bounty of gold. Casting Track does not take you out of invisibility.
notes_zh: 只要目标在追踪术期间以任何方式死亡，赏金猎人都能获得金钱奖励。
追踪术效果仅对友方单位可见。
鼠标移至目标技能栏上方的负面效果图标可以看到目标携带的金钱数额。
金钱奖励为不可靠金钱。

objects.subject: weaver_the_swarm
objects.description_zh: 编织者放出%count%只编织者幼虫，每只幼虫都会紧紧缠住它遇到的敌人，攻击敌人并削弱他们的护甲，直到幼虫被杀死。
objects.description_en: Weaver launches a swarm of %count% young Weavers that latch on any enemy unit in their path, attacking and reducing armor until it is killed.
notes_zh: 甲虫抓住目标后将一直留在目标身上，除非甲虫被击杀或持续时间结束。
甲虫免疫技能，需要一个单位的%destroy_attacks%次攻击才能被击杀。英雄造成双倍伤害。
幼虫提供视野。

objects.subject: weaver_shukuchi
objects.description_zh: 编织者进入隐身身，达到移动速度上限，在穿过敌方单位时还将造成伤害。
objects.description_en: Weaver shifts out of visibility, gaining max movement speed and doing harm to any enemies it passes through.
notes_zh: 每次施放的技能只能对相同单位造成一次伤害。

shard.zh: 缩地在造成伤害的敌人身上留下一个标记，持续%geminate_attack_mark_duration%秒。编织者脱离缩地状态%shukuchi_attack_delay%秒后，附近%shukuchi_attack_mark_radius%范围内拥有印记的敌人都会被连击的第二次攻击击中。
shard.en: Shukuchi puts a mark on enemies it damages that last %geminate_attack_mark_duration% seconds. %shukuchi_attack_delay%s after Weaver exits Shukuchi, enemies with a mark within %shukuchi_attack_mark_radius% range will also be attacked with a secondary Geminate attack

objects.subject: weaver_time_lapse
objects.description_zh:
编织者回到五秒前的时间点，获得当时的生命值和魔法值。不影响冷却时间、金钱和经验。

驱散类型：强驱散
objects.description_en:
Weaver warps backward to whatever position it was in five seconds earlier--regaining the HP and mana from that time. No effect on cooldown, gold or experience.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
notes_zh: 能够移除编织者身上大部分的负面状态。
时光倒流可以躲避攻击和技能弹道。

scepter.zh: 时光倒流可以对%abilitycastrange%施法距离内的友方英雄施放。
scepter.en: Time Lapse may target allied Heroes with %abilitycastrange% cast range.

objects.subject: weaver_threads_of_fate
objects.description_zh: 每当编织者的攻击或技能对敌方英雄造成伤害后，如果编织者在他们%thread_setup_distance%范围内停留达到%thread_setup_time%秒，他就会织出命运之线，短暂减速敌人并把他们与编织者相连。每织出一条命运之线就会使编织者获得攻击力加成。
objects.description_en: Whenever Weaver deals damage to an enemy hero with an attack or ability, if he remains within %thread_setup_distance% range of them for %thread_setup_time%s, he establishes a Thread of Fate that briefly slows the enemy and ties Weaver and the enemy together. Each established thread of fate grants bonus damage to Weaver.

objects.subject: jakiro_dual_breath
objects.description_zh: 杰奇洛对面前的敌人先后喷出寒冰和火焰。寒冰吐息减速敌人，火焰吐息对敌人造成持续伤害。
objects.description_en: An icy blast followed by a wave of fire launches out in a path in front of Jakiro. The ice slows enemies, while the fire delivers damage over time.
notes_zh: 最远能伤害1025距离外的单位。
两次吐息有%fire_delay%秒的间隔。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。
